RAJYA SABHA [7 August, 2002] 
Hon. Members, it is with utmost grief and sorrow that I refer to the 
dastardly killing of at least 9 Amamath pilgrims and injury to several others 
by militants curing this year's Amarnath Yatra at Nunwan base camp near 
Pahalgam in Jammu and Kashmir on Tuesday, the 6th August, 2002. No 
words are strong enough to condemn this heinous act. I am sure the whole 
House will condemn this cowardly act and would join me in offering 
condolences to the bereaved families and also pray for early recovery of those 
who have been injured. 
I request Members to rise in their places and observe silence as a 
mark of respect to the memory of those who lost their lives in this tragedy. 
[Hon. Members' stood in silence for one minute.] 
Now, you have cooperated very well. We will have the questions.
